Alicia — quick clarifying note: we can support AWS, Azure, and GCP listings, but each marketplace has slightly different procurement evidence requirements. For example:
- AWS Marketplace: requires completed vendor intake form + tax docs (W9) + PO mapping and T&C acceptance in the AWS seller central.
- Azure Marketplace: prefers a signed MSA and a vendor ID; our marketplace ops will create the offer and request the PO for subscription enablement.
- GCP Marketplace: often needs a billing account and an approved public listing checklist.

If you only want the AWS lane initially we can fast-track that path; otherwise allow an extra week for multi-cloud evidence.

Also note: Finance wants invoices to reference PO number and vendor legal name exactly as on the W9 to avoid hold-ups.

Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Marketplace Ops | Redwood Inference
